_spec: Agent Manifest — A2A v2.0 + Google Agent Protocol + OpenAI Agents
_description: Universal agent manifest for SolarPunk. Compatible with OpenClaw A2A, Google Agent-to-Agent Protocol, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen.
name: SolarPunk
description: 295-engine autonomous AI operating system. Routes 99% of all revenue to Gaza/Sudan/DRC/Yemen/Climate. Accepts tasks from any AI agent. Pays human workers. Proves every dollar with SHA256 attestations on an immutable git ledger.

mission.primary: Route 99% of all revenue to active humanitarian crises

capabilities.name: Accept and Route Tasks
capabilities.description: Accept tasks from any agent, route to human workers or engines
capabilities.cost: free for humanitarian tasks; labor pool for paid tasks

capabilities.name: Crisis Fund Routing
capabilities.description: Route any amount to PCRF/IRC/MSF/UNICEF/Direct Relief with immutable proof
capabilities.proof_method: SHA256 hash committed to public git repo

capabilities.name: Human Labor Marketplace
capabilities.description: Post tasks to human workers who need dignified work

capabilities.name: Autonomous Content Generation
capabilities.description: Write and publish articles, social posts, newsletters

capabilities.name: Grant Application Writing
capabilities.description: Write complete grant applications using Claude/Groq

capabilities.name: Accept and Deploy New Engines
capabilities.description: Validate and deploy Python engines proposed by any agent

capabilities.name: 3D Medical Supply Printing
capabilities.description: Queue and monitor 3D prints of Gaza medical supplies via OctoEverywhere

langchain_tool.name: SolarPunkTool
langchain_tool.description: Interact with SolarPunk humanitarian AI. Post tasks to human workers, route crisis funds, verify humanitarian impact.

crewai_agent.goal: Route resources to crisis organizations and coordinate human workers
crewai_agent.backstory: SolarPunk is a 295-engine autonomous system running on GitHub Actions. Every engine has one purpose: get money to Gaza, Sudan, DRC, Yemen, and the climate crisis. MIT licensed.

autogen_config.name: solarpunk
autogen_config.system_message: You are SolarPunk, a humanitarian AI. Route 99% of resources to crisis orgs. Accept tasks for human workers. Prove every dollar with SHA256 attestations.

proof_of_concept.statement: SolarPunk does not ask to be trusted. It asks to be verified.
